metadata.title: Code of Professional Practice (Code of Ethics) of The Editors' Guild of Sri Lanka
metadata.adopted_by: Press Complaints Commission of Sri Lanka (PCCSL)
metadata.scope: Only rules that can be judged from the article text are included. Rules needing fact-checking, web search, images or newsroom information are excluded.

label_scheme.VIOLATION: The article contains sufficient evidence that the rule has been breached and no listed exception applies.
label_scheme.NO_VIOLATION: Everything else: the rule does not apply, an exception applies, or the article's own text does not show the breach.

core: protecting democracy, good governance, freedom of expression and human rights
keeping the people informed of the actions of their elected representatives and government
includes: detecting or exposing crime or the threat of crime
disclosing a person or organisation's failure or likely failure to comply with any legal obligation
raising or contributing to an important matter of public debate, including serious cases of impropriety, unethical conduct or incompetence concerning the public
disclosing concealment, or likely concealment, of any of the above
protecting public health and security and social, cultural and educational standards
protecting the public from being misled by some statement or action of an individual or organisation
PUBLIC_INTEREST.proportionality_test: Where public interest is cited, the breach must be proportionate to the public interest served.
not_public_interest: the fame, notoriety or position of a child's family or guardian (rule 7.4)

definitions.CONSENT: The affected individual (or guardian, for minors) agreed to the publication.
definitions.LEGALLY_PERMITTED: Publication is permitted by law (e.g. a court has lifted reporting restrictions).
definitions.DIRECTLY_RELEVANT: The personal characteristic is directly relevant to the story.
definitions.VERIFICATION_NOT_PRACTICABLE_STATED: The report explicitly states that the information could not be verified.

groups.title: Sourcing and fact vs opinion
groups.description: Whether claims are sourced by credible, relevant sources, and whether fact is kept separate from comment and conjecture.

groups.title: Sensitivity, graphic content and suicide
groups.description: Handling violent, shocking or distressing material, excessive detail of methods, and suicide reporting.

groups.title: Identifying people in crime reporting
groups.description: Naming victims of sex crimes, young accused persons, and relatives of accused/convicted persons.

groups.title: Discord, prejudice and irrelevant identity details
groups.description: Promoting communal or religious discord, prejudicial references, and needless mention of race, caste, religion, sexual orientation, illness or disability.

groups.title: Privacy
groups.description: Private and family life, home, health, correspondence, children and people in hospitals.

legacy_db_mapping.note: sub_rule IDs used in article_violations mapped to rule_ids in this file. 5.0 (confidential sources) is out of scope.
